svg.title: Poseborne: from radio links to 18-joint 2D pose
svg.desc: Three transmitters and three receivers provide nine CSI links. The default amplitude feature tensor has shape 280 by 3 by 3. A ResNet-18-style WiSPPN encoder produces a 3 by 18 by 18 pose adjacency matrix; its diagonal gives 18 two-dimensional joints and confidence. A separate synchronized-camera teacher and paired-CSI training branch saves a required, unbundled checkpoint. Signal textures and pose glyphs are schematic.
